boundaries: Every reference binds an explicit identity/revision; evidence pins exact source bytes.
Artifact identity, represented subject, ontology node, source standing and runtime permission remain distinct.
Generated graphs cannot replace authored design or prove their own semantic adequacy.

claim_ceiling: Complete source-bound Definition/v2 candidate only. No canonical semantic admission, runtime implementation, authority grant or full-chain qualification is asserted.

scope.applicability: Definitions and records construction across Lab Product/Project workspaces using the required seven-stage chain.
exclusions: Redefining admitted foundational meanings or creating duplicate Ontology/Artifact/Schema types.
Canonical registry admission, source-profile/store migration or operational permissions.
Treating existing tests as full construction-chain evidence.

examples: Record meaning traces through schema, business rule, bridge decision, system operation, AlchLang resource and generated check.
A generated graph cannot fill a missing upstream design.
domain_context.explanation: Business, bridge and system ontologies specialize the admitted Ontology meaning through profiles; this proposal does not give them new authority.

plain_language.explanation: A handoff says what moves to the next stage, how it is interpreted, what must remain true, and what blocks continuation.

scientific_formal.formal_expression: ValidHandoff(H) implies adjacent(from(H),to(H)) and exact_bindings(H) and declared_transform(H) and closed_required_coverage(H) and distinct_authority(H).
scientific_formal.normative_statement: A Construction Stage Handoff is an identifiable, version-exact transfer specification between two adjacent stages of one selected Construction Chain Contract. It binds exact input/output subject revisions and bytes, source standing, scope and owner routes, authored or mechanical transformation, rationale, preservation and coverage obligations, validation evidence and unresolved residue. It grants no authority and cannot equate an ontology representation with its subject or generated output with semantic acceptance. A missing required target blocks downstream conformance; changing an input invalidates the dependent handoff and its transitive results.

notation.meaning: one selected exact handoff specification identified by its manifest binding

testable_conditions: Selected stage order and adjacent handoffs are exact and closed.
Required mapping/reference targets resolve on the same cut.
Missing or stale prerequisites block conformant generation.
Source bytes, candidate standing and owner routes remain distinct.
